name: Wailing Crystals AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

stealth.note: (master) or @Check[perception|dc:37|name:Notice Ghostly Faces|traits:hazard,complex,environmental,magical] (master) to notice what appear to be screaming ghostly faces in the crystals

description: Three clusters of gleaming, colorful crystals are corrupted with necromantic energy that causes them to reflect negative emotions. All three must be disabled or destroyed to negate the hazard.
disable: DC 29 Thievery (master) to carefully fracture the crystals or DC 27 Crafting (expert) to place objects to stop the resonance, both disabling one 5-foot patch of crystals.
reset: The wailing crystals deactivate and reset once no living creatures are within 20 feet.
routine: (3 actions) The hazard uses each action for an Anguished Shriek. The wailing crystals lose 1 action for each 5-foot patch of crystals that is broken or destroyed.

generalAbilities.name: HP is 72 for each 5 foot patch
Echoing Cry
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 20 feet of a wailing crystal.

Effect A despairing chorus of cries echoes off the crystals, working its way into the minds of all living creatures in Jewelgate Way Station, affecting them with Wave of Despair (7th level, DC 33 Will Saving Throw save).

The hazard rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Anguished Shriek
generalAbilities.description: A shrieking, distorted face composed of writhing necromantic energy lances out of the crystals to target a random living creature within 20 feet. The target takes 4d6 Mental Damage]{4d6 mental damage and 4d6 sonic damage} (Basic DC 33 Will Saving Throw save).
